description: Land Acquisition - Gangodawila, Sri Jayawardnepura Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District, Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 2141/17 of 18.09.2019
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire 107 specific land allotments for a storm water drainage and environmental improvement project. The content focuses exclusively on land descriptions, property assessments, and acquisition details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
